bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to transportation; appropriating money for safe road zones grants.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. SAFE ROAD ZONES GRANTS; APPROPRIATION.

$1,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of public safety for grants to local units of government to perform additional traffic safety enforcement activities in safe road zones under Minnesota Statutes, section 169.065. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until June 30, 2027.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: $1,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of public safety for grants to local units of government to perform additional traffic safety enforcement activities in safe road zones under Minnesota Statutes, section 169.065. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until June 30, 2027.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
